config.desc.combat.death_save_alerts: Shows a large !You've Been Saved By ...! message in the center of the screen when Spirit Mask, Bonzo's Mask, or Phoenix saves you from death.
config.desc.combat.spirit_mask_cooldown_: Shows Spirit Mask's longest possible remaining cooldown after it saves you. Dungeon cooldown reductions may make the ability ready before this countdown ends.
config.desc.combat.bonzo_mask_cooldown_h: Shows Bonzo's Mask's longest possible remaining cooldown after it saves you. Dungeon cooldown reductions may make the ability ready before this countdown ends.
config.desc.combat.phoenix_cooldown_hud: Shows Phoenix's exact 60-second Rekindle cooldown after it saves you from death.
config.desc.combat.deployable_expiry: Shows a center-screen warning when your Power Orb or Flare has fully despawned. It does not warn when you only leave its effect range.
config.desc.century_cake: Tracks all client-received Century Cake refreshes for 48 real-world hours and warns when any effect expires. One master switch controls every cake effect.
config.desc.party.auto_accept: Automatically accepts party invites from the selected friend type. Whitelisted players are always accepted. Open /friend list and view every page to sync your friends.
config.desc.chat.dm_party_request: Invites the sender when a private message is exactly !p, !party, or !invite. Disabled by default.
config.desc.chat.quick_private_party_req: Turns a supported local double-slash request into /msg <player> !p. Disabled by default.
config.desc.chat.fast_party_commands: Converts supported ! commands sent in party chat into party, dungeon, and Kuudra commands. Every child command and trigger scope is independent.
config.desc.commands.party_commands: Enables local client-side command aliases for party, dungeon, and Kuudra actions. This command family is independent from Fast Party Command.
config.desc.manual_reconnect: Adds a Reconnect button to connection-failed and disconnected screens. It never retries automatically.
config.desc.fishing.bite_alert: Plays the bundled Ciallo sound once when your water or lava fishing hook shows !!!. Disabled by default.
config.desc.dwarven_map: Approximate one-layer X/Z overview with a live player arrow.
config.desc.glacite_map: Readable low, middle, and high tunnel layers.
config.desc.mining_tracker: Current commissions and all three mining powders.
config.desc.hunting.alert_sound: Master mute for center-screen alerts; each alert has its own sound and volume settings.
config.desc.hunting.cold_safety: Two configurable Cold warnings and a red beacon on the nearest loaded campfire.
config.desc.hunting.doomspiral_ready: Warn when the inventory contains the 4 Soothing Incense required to summon Doomspiral.
config.desc.hunting.warden_ready: Center alert and sound when the Doomspiral Warden's capture cooldown ends.
config.desc.hunting.fairy_souls: Pink beacon beams at official Torrhus Canyon and Critter Safari Fairy Soul coordinates.
config.desc.hunting.critter_highlight: Outline named capturable Critters using the official rarity color of their Shard.
config.desc.hunting.torrhus_tracker: Helia chapter task, progress, Whispers, Essence, Sweep, and Forest Fortune.
config.desc.hunting.galatea_tracker: Hina chapter task, progress, Whispers, Essence, Sweep, and Forest Fortune.
config.desc.hunting.tree_critter_timer: Shows the received Tree Protection Order Critter countdown in the combined Hunting HUD.
config.desc.hunting.beeheemoth: Custom outline plus a temporary yellow beacon at the first visible spawn position.
config.desc.hunting.lasso_reel_sound: Plays one local sound when your visible Lasso state first changes to REEL.
config.desc.hunting.miria_contest: Next bracket score, expected Safari Ticket, and remaining score.
config.desc.hunting.agatha_contest: Next bracket score, expected Safari Ticket, and remaining score.
config.desc.hunting.critter_behavior: Center warnings and received progress for special Torrhus capture mechanics.
config.desc.hunting.benefactor: Received Benefactor state, timer, effects, and contribution details.
config.desc.hunting.tree_gift: Center alert when an enabled rare reward appears in Tree Gift chat.
config.desc.hunting.safari_dashboard: Elapsed run time and Ticket Tier without duplicating Safari Essence.
config.desc.hunting.safari_shard_stats: Shows captured Safari Shards grouped by biome in the Hunting HUD. Off by default.
config.desc.hunting.safari_critterdex: Session capture progress plus complete captured or missing name lists.
config.desc.hunting.sparkling: Center warning, sound, biome, and optional vanilla entity outline.
config.desc.hunting.floor_quest: Nearby floor-drop warning and locally held Safari quest items.
config.desc.hunting.wumpa: Encounter phase and center warnings from received chat and visible entities.
config.desc.hunting.safari_belt: Embed observed biome milestones and received attribute bonuses in its tooltip.

config.desc.hunting.snoozle_wall: Overlay nearby Cobbled Deepslate and Tuff breakable-wall surfaces in the Safari Cavern.
config.desc.crimson_tasks: Faction quests received from the Crimson Isle Tab widget.
config.desc.dragon_highlight: Vanilla outline for Ender Dragons in The End.
config.desc.pet_hud: Equipped pet, level, XP, and progress from chat and Tab.
config.desc.shard_fusion: Search Shard fusion recipes by English name and inspect their ingredients locally.
config.desc.chat_peek: Hold a custom key to show and optionally scroll chat history.
config.desc.item_timestamps: Add creation dates and local completion times to item lore.

config.desc.teleport_sounds: Keep the original teleport sounds or replace each one with a chosen local sound.
